list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as published; every guide below is written for this entry, in its own words, and names its sources.

exophase.what: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades

notes.missable: PowerPyx and GTABase agree that only one trophy is potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude, because its first meditation can only be done in Chapter 1. Every story trophy unlocks automatically as you play, and there is no mission replay in GTA VI, so PowerPyx advises keeping a manual save at the start and the end of each chapter.
notes.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving, according to PowerPyx, GTABase and Push Square. Keep cheats off for the whole run.
notes.estimates: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours to the platinum in one playthrough, with no online trophies and no difficulty setting. The story runs five chapters and takes about 60-80 hours.
notes.unconfirmed: Where PowerPyx marks a trophy as currently unknown, this guide says so plainly instead of guessing.
notes.hiddenFlags: The hidden flag is set for the 12 story trophies, which every list agrees are hidden on PlayStation until earned. The full list has 28 hidden trophies; which of the other 16 side trophies are hidden was not confirmed by a second source at launch, so they are left unflagged rather than guessed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx confirms it needs no multiplayer and no DLC, and the whole set is single-player and offline. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below, not a task of its own: the last trophy you earn will usually be the 100% gold, A Long Road, or one of the clean-up trophies in stage 4.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: play the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops when the mission ends. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable, like every story trophy, because it unlocks from story progress alone. Nothing to prepare and nothing to watch for — just play the opening.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it actually unlocks when you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so do not worry if it does not pop at the chapter's last cutscene. While you are in Chapter 1, do the one thing in the game that can be missed: the balcony meditation at Jason's house for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2; PowerPyx reports it pops when the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: after the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and roam together, which is when the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best) become possible.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3; PowerPyx reports it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is also when several questlines open — Andy's, Randy's, Tyrone's and the jewelry jobs that unlock the Snap Gun — so take the side quests as they appear; they stay available after the story, but doing them now teaches you the robbery systems the later trophies need.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4; PowerPyx reports it pops when you complete the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. The same mission also pops the gold for the final mission (You Gotta Know When to Get Off), so this is effectively the end of the main story path.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, the gold for finishing the final mission, Starting From Zero, at the end of Chapter 4 (PowerPyx). Once it pops, the game returns you to free-roam and the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — that checklist is the whole of stage 3 of the roadmap, so do not stop playing here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable: just follow the story and it pops when the mission ends. There are no gold medals for missions in GTA VI, so you never need to replay a mission for a rating.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It pops from story progress alone (PowerPyx), so there is no special objective to chase inside the mission — finish it however you like and move on.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies it unlocks by finishing the mission (PowerPyx) — no optional objective, no collectible inside it, and no way to miss it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. PowerPyx confirms it unlocks from story progress alone and cannot be missed. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops with it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. It pops when the mission ends (PowerPyx). The airport itself matters for another trophy — Catch Me If You Can, stealing a docked passenger plane from the same airport — but that one is free-roam, not part of this mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory (PowerPyx). It is the last of the mission-named story trophies, so once it pops your story set is nearly done — only the chapter and final-mission trophies remain, and they follow automatically.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for the 100% completion checklist, and the hardest trophy in the set according to PowerPyx. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. The requirements are lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles are only partly required, and you need any 70 of the 80 challenges. The only lines that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. The checklist needs 100 optional missions (there are 200-300+), 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned with the WAiNK app, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, and 300 stunts. Work it in stage 3, after the story, and it will absorb most of the other trophies on the way.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game; the 100% checklist needs 300 of them, so keep going past this trophy. PowerPyx breaks the 397 down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps, and says the under-bridge flights are the quickest to farm. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, where each stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done. Performing a stunt once counts — the extra challenges shown on its map icon are not required.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The trophy tracker counts 9 types, viewable under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, where scrolling over each type shows how many you have done (PowerPyx). The types are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Most are introduced by the story or marked when you unfog the map — filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) — and PowerPyx notes you will do one of each almost automatically while working on the other trophies, so do not chase this one early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across 12 shooting range locations (PowerPyx). This is one of the few lines the 100% checklist needs in full, so there is no skipping a hard one — but PowerPyx rates the gold medals as not too difficult. Ranges are an activity type too, so your first visit also counts toward Master of None. Practise a range until the gold threshold is comfortable, then move on; coming back with better weapons and a higher Focus level makes the later ones easier.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total (PowerPyx). Drone races are one of the lines the 100% checklist needs in full. Each location hosts several races, so learn the course, cut the corners the drones allow, and retry a race immediately if you lose — there is no penalty for retrying. A win at every location pops the trophy; the checklist wants every race won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, at 20 different locations — PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations in the game, so there are twice as many as you need. Races count toward the activity types for Master of None as well. Pick the short circuits first, use a fast car you have tuned, and retry freely; each location only needs one win, so move on as soon as you have it.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is met in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; some time after it he texts you a fishing location, marked with a purple icon on the map, and following his fishing questline leads to the challenge (PowerPyx). Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and it raises your Focus, which helps Gunslinger later — so treat Cal's line as an early-game errand, not a chore to leave for the end.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all of its levels at least once. There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck (PowerPyx). The first three are playable on the TV at home, from Chapter 1, by interacting with the controllers; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. You do not need to beat every challenge inside a game, only reach its end, and any of the four counts — pick the one you enjoy most.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3. While playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address that marks the questline on the map in Belville (PowerPyx). Her five quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story, so there is no rush — but Andy's line is one of the questlines the 100% checklist's optional-mission count can use.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; a while after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is then marked with the green KR icon in Key Lento (PowerPyx). He hands out sets of treasure-diving quests — 7 shipwrecks in total — marking purple treasure chest icons on the map; dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees, and Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so the line is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County (PowerPyx). His five quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story, so do them whenever you are passing through Kelly County.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx warns that the named-character questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) do not count as strangers for this trophy, even though they are side content. Strands confirmed to count are Kirk's Skunk Ape line (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle's farm line (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago's racing line (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete's delivery line (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries). All strangers stay available after the story in free-roam, and your count is visible in the trophy tracker. PowerPyx notes more strands are still being discovered, so keep this for stage 4 and sweep the map icons then.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, which is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner (PowerPyx). He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — the Zorrusso is already done as part of that mission, leaving cars like the Pegassi Vitello, Infernus and Toros, the Buckingham Windsor Drop and Jubilee, and the Grotti Itali RSX. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars in fixed locations, but you can also steal one off the street — scanning or entering a wanted car pops a delivery prompt. Deliver in good condition for more money, and look around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, where the cars are often parked outside hotels. It all stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and available only as Jason (PowerPyx). Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finishing it pops the trophy. It all stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, across 10 locations. You can meditate as both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you can track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations (PowerPyx). THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation can only be done in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway, because after Chapter 1 it is permanently gone. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of the 18 meditations are needed, so this trophy is the only reason to be thorough here.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline is marked at some point after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive the message, so this line is Jason-only (PowerPyx). Do that quest and he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. In the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves an animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, all needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy should come naturally. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx's guide to the cards lists 18 card set locations across Leonida, so there are far more sets than the three you need — pick the sets whose cards are closest together and finish those. Cards are a collectible type the 100% checklist only partly requires, so you do not need every card in the game, only three finished sets. Mark each set's locations on the map as you find them and sweep them in one route.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad and then R1 to scan objects in the environment (PowerPyx). There are far more than 100 scannable things — PowerPyx lists 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures among them — so any 100 count. Make scanning a habit from Chapter 1: the app unlocks early, scanning vehicles with it also feeds Whip It Good and the 100% checklist's 200-vehicle scan, and every scan is progress you never have to repeat.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of the 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there — PowerPyx advises leaving challenges for last, then picking the easiest ones you have left. Track them under Progress, Challenges, where scrolling over a challenge shows a Completed checkmark. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, so do not grind them early.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle (PowerPyx). Then cause chaos until you hit 4 stars and break out of the red heat zone on the map; the trophy pops when you drive out of that zone, not when you leave the flashing search area. PowerPyx's easiest escape is a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic, or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally later: the bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal always trigger 4-star wanted levels, so do not force it early if you would rather wait.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — do not lose the wanted level between shops. This also needs the post-Coffee Break partner system (hold right on the D-pad, press triangle to call your partner). Hit robbery targets marked with green icons while the police chase you, keeping the red/blue flashing wanted level rather than letting it drop or rising to the red heat level (PowerPyx). Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs if you can, and if the trophy does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes — and the fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it (PowerPyx). You only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this trophy pops automatically if you scan from the start.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina (PowerPyx). It only lasts a few seconds, so prepare first — eat or drink to buff focus, wash your face or shower at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press triangle) to extend it. Then line up 5 enemies and drop them quickly without missing; gang operations are a good place to find grouped enemies, and an assault rifle like the Duke 556 beats pistols and SMGs here. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by the time you reach Focus level 4 this gets much easier, so leave it for stage 3 if it resists you early.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and fly away with it. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the planes parked on the airfield do not count (PowerPyx). The easiest is the one at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge, whose door leads directly into the plane. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy is delayed until you are that far out. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and use it. The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County (PowerPyx). Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, get into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so bring armor and do not linger outside the tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked with a green icon on unfogged map areas (PowerPyx). Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently, and approaching a locked door offers the kick (loud, triggers the alarm) or the Snap Gun (stealth). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm; the trophy pops shortly after you leave. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape — the 100% checklist needs all 8, so you will pass this trophy on the way. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash in, the vault opens, and you go in while it is open (PowerPyx). You cannot carry all the cash alone — bring your partner and hold right on the D-pad to hand off a bag. After that mission, pay Yasmani for tips about security vans ($10,000 a tip, after his earlier quests robbing 2 Payday Loans); he marks vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. Each vault pays up to $205,000, making this the best endgame money-maker too. Your robbed vaults are shown when you scroll over their map icons.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck (PowerPyx). If you want it earlier, armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open. Either way the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius, so get clear or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani becomes a fence automatically from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible (PowerPyx). Do it after the story, when you have a plane and the time to sweep systematically, working region by region so no fog patch is left. The map's exploration view shows what is still hidden, and the flight itself doubles as vehicle discovery for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy pops on the way (PowerPyx). Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, at the bottom right. Do one per gang early to bank the trophy, then finish the rest during the checklist stage.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar, with the Ocean Beach view in front of you (PowerPyx). That is the whole trophy — a small scenic errand, best done during the stage 4 clean-up sweep when you are already around Ocean Beach for other things. PowerPyx had marked this one as not yet known at first, so the rooftop-bar detail comes from its updated guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III (PowerPyx). You can only take it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (stealing the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and keep driving: the trophy is slightly delayed and pops once you are further down the street. It only unlocks from this specific blue Banshee, not from any other car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Before you go, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe (PowerPyx). You first go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, the valuables are the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — all marked with a golden icon. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. It is not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for the remaining valuables.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, select a character and scroll to Strength (the heart icon) (PowerPyx). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities, the dumbbell icon), and always go together with both characters (hold right on the D-pad, press triangle to call your partner): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the PSN tracker counts to 500, viewable by opening this trophy in the trophy list (PowerPyx). Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On) and a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do affects your reputation. The profiles run from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence) through Hardened (incapacitating without killing) and Violent (killing enemies and civilians) to Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones), and Irredeemable is a permanent status from excessive violence that makes cops more aggressive — PowerPyx advises avoiding it. Almost every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this should come passively while you finish the other trophies; if it is still short at the end, it can be farmed quickly, though that pushes your profile toward the harsher end.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest answer: this trophy is currently unknown. PowerPyx lists it as unknown and believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but that is a guess, not a confirmed method — so this guide does not invent steps for it. Check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates: it is the source most likely to pin it down first, and the trophy will almost certainly pop from ordinary play around the Payday Loans content. Do not grind anything for it until a source confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County (PowerPyx). The spawn is slightly random: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside, sometimes not — if it is not there, drive away and come back. When the car is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and when she asks, go back to her car at the roadside — the trophy pops then.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Honest answer: this trophy is currently unknown. PowerPyx lists it as unknown and believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by, matching the description — but that is a guess, not a confirmed method, so this guide does not present it as fact. Try knocking enemies over with a melee attack from a moving motorcycle and see if it pops; if it does not, check the linked PowerPyx guide for the confirmed trigger as more players test it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts — it counts across all robberies, not in one trip. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills (PowerPyx). Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but vaults only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, so expect this to finish during the stage 3 robbery sweep, not before.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — every shop type counts toward the same total. The fastest way is the most expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos (PowerPyx). There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so you will not run out of places to spend. Do your ordinary shopping first and check the total late in the run; if it is short, buy a weapon or a car mod to close the gap. It pairs naturally with Little Boxes, since garage purchases are the biggest single expense.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — there are 4 more story-related garages that do not count. Together the 8 cost $160,000 (PowerPyx). Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (stealing the Crawler for Moses), when you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone; buy them through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4 and the bank vaults at up to $205,000 each. Buying the garages also adds the parking spots you need for On the Spot, so do this trophy before that one.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (taking a vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere (PowerPyx). You need enough garages first — see Little Boxes — because each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. Moses initially only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
